subject: Billing cutover & escrow holdback for Innova Labs acquisition
messages:
From: Sonia Patel <sonia.patel@innovalabs.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Innova AP <ap@innovalabs.com>, Tom Reyes <tom.reyes@lawbridge.com>
Date: 2027-05-03T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Billing cutover timeline and holdback for Redwood invoices

Hi Vivek —

Congrats on getting the integration across the finish line. Per the acquisition closing yesterday, Innova Labs will be transitioning billing to our parent entity (Innova Holdings LLC). Finance has asked for a short transition plan: key dates for invoice cutoff, where remittance should be sent for May/June invoices, and a 90-day escrow/holdback on new invoices related to usage prior to close.

Attached is a suggested billing handoff workbook (innova_integration_billing_plan_v1.xlsx) and a signed remit letter. Can you confirm Redwood’s acceptance of the holdback approach and provide a routing account for invoice submission? If helpful, our outside counsel Tom is on copy to confirm wording.

Thanks —
Sonia Patel
VP Finance, Innova Labs
sonia.patel@innovalabs.com
+1 415-555-0198

Attachments: innova_integration_billing_plan_v1.xlsx, remit_letter_signed.pdf

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sonia Patel <sonia.patel@innovalabs.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-05-03T10:07:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Billing cutover timeline and holdback for Redwood invoices

Sonia —

Thanks and congrats to the Innova team. We can support a temporary 90-day retention for invoices covering usage before the close, but need to align on specifics:

- Which legal name should appear on invoices dated after 2027-05-01? (you suggested Innova Holdings LLC)
- Confirm EDI/BACS or bank details for remittance, and whether AP will still accept Redwood invoices to ap@innovalabs.com during the transition.
- Exact escrow trigger & release conditions (we usually need a signed agreement or PO amendment).

Looping in Laura (finance lead) and Ben (legal ops) to confirm our internal acceptance and required paperwork. I’ll take the workbook and draft a short amendment that captures the 90-day holdback and release criteria.

Next steps: Laura, can you review the workbook and advise what info we need to issue invoices to Innova Holdings vs Redwood Inc? Ben, can you weigh in on the minimal amendment language to support the holdback?

Best,
Vivek
Account Exec — Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

--- Original attachment references: innova_integration_billing_plan_v1.xlsx, remit_letter_signed.pdf

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Sonia Patel <sonia.patel@innovalabs.com>
Date: 2027-05-03T12:01:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Billing cutover timeline and holdback for Redwood invoices

Vivek / team —

I reviewed the workbook. From a collections and tax perspective we need the following to change our billing entity and remit routing cleanly:

- Legal entity name (exact): Innova Holdings LLC
- New EIN / Tax ID: 12-3456789 (please confirm via signed remit_letter_signed.pdf)
- Address for 1099 / tax forms and VAT/withholding reporting: 1601 Market St, Suite 400, San Francisco, CA 94103
- Bank remit instructions for ACH / wire: routing/account details (we prefer a test wire / micro-deposit before cutting cycles)

Regarding the 90-day holdback: Redwood is fine with a temporary escrow for pre-close usage, provided we have:
  1) a signed amendment that specifies the charge period and release conditions;
  2) a single point of contact in Innova AP for release requests; and
  3) confirmation that retained amounts will not be netted against future invoices without written agreement.

I’ll draft a short amendment and share a tracked version by EOD. Ben, can you prepare the legal language for the holdback?

Laura Bennett
Head of Finance, Redwood Inference

Attachment referenced: purchase_agreement_excerpt.pdf

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Sonia Patel <sonia.patel@innovalabs.com>, Tom Reyes <tom.reyes@lawbridge.com>
Date: 2027-05-04T08:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Billing cutover timeline and holdback for Redwood invoices

Quick draft language (summary):

"Redwood will invoice Innova Holdings LLC for usage occurring on or after the first day following the closing date. For invoices covering the period up to and including the closing date, Innova Holdings LLC agrees to retain 90% of the invoiced amount in escrow for a period of 90 days from invoice date; 10% will be released to Redwood upon invoice issuance to cover immediate operational costs. Release of escrowed funds requires a written release request from Innova AP and confirmation of no outstanding disputes for the invoiced period. Escrowed funds will be paid by wire to Redwood’s nominated account within 10 business days of valid release."

I flagged two items for counsel: (1) who signs the escrow release (AP vs CFO), and (2) whether the 10% immediate release is acceptable to Innova. Tom — any objections?

Ben Carter
Legal Ops, Redwood Inference

From: Sonia Patel <sonia.patel@innovalabs.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Innova AP <ap@innovalabs.com>, Tom Reyes <tom.reyes@lawbridge.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-05-04T11:33:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Billing cutover timeline and holdback for Redwood invoices

Ben / team —

That wording looks fine to us. We confirm:
- Entity name: Innova Holdings LLC (EIN 12-3456789) — remit_letter_signed.pdf confirms signatory authority.
- Innova agrees to 10% immediate release, 90% held for 90 days. CFO approval included.
- Innova AP will be the single release request contact (ap@innovalabs.com) and CFO (sonia.patel@innovalabs.com) will sign off on disputed items.

We’ll need Redwood to issue the final amendment and an updated invoice template (with new legal name and TAX ID). Can Redwood also accept payment net of the 10% immediate release in the first settlement so our cash ops are aligned?

Sonia

Attachment: remit_letter_signed.pdf

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sonia Patel <sonia.patel@innovalabs.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>, Innova AP <ap@innovalabs.com>
Date: 2027-05-05T15:40:00-07:00
Subject: Final: Amendment & invoice template for Innova Holdings LLC (for execution)

Sonia —

Thanks for the fast turnaround. Attached is the short amendment and an updated invoice template that lists Innova Holdings LLC and the confirmed EIN. Key points:

- Redwood will submit invoices to ap@innovalabs.com and copy remit@innova-holdings.com (new remit mailbox) for the month of May and June.
- For invoices with charge periods ending on or before 2027-05-01, Redwood will issue the invoice, collect 10% on the first settlement, and hold 90% in escrow per the amendment.
- Release process: Innova AP sends a release request to remit@innova-holdings.com with CFO approval; Redwood will then release escrowed funds by wire within 10 business days to the account on file.
- We verified bank routing with Innova AP; we will schedule a $1 test transfer before the next cycle.

Please confirm by reply-all and, if agreed, sign the amendment via the DocuSign link below so we can update our billing system. Once signed we’ll push the first updated invoice.

DocuSign: https://na1.docusign.net/Member/PowerFormSigning.aspx?PowerFormId=abc123
HubSpot record: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/company/67890

Best regards,
Marissa Cole
Revenue Operations, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com

Attachments: purchase_agreement_excerpt.pdf, innova_integration_billing_plan_v1.xlsx
